GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   C. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   B. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   D. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   D. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Treat Rocks as rumours only.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

12. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   C. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

15. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   C. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
